summary: CUSTOM THEME BUILDER (Tier-3 / iteration 31) — ALL TESTS PASSED. Logged in as applereview@cheerplanner.app on /settings/appearance and exercised every flow described in the review request. (T1) Tapped custom-accent-#7C3AED + custom-mode-dark + custom-apply: PATCH /api/household/theme returned 200 with body {preset_id:'custom', custom:{accent:'#7C3AED', accentSubtle:'#7C3AED33', bg:'#0F172A', card:'#1E293B', textPrimary:'#F8FAFC', tabActive:'#7C3AED'}}. Appearance and Dashboard both flipped live to rgb(15, 23, 42) (=#0F172A) and 12 elements rendered with rgb(124, 58, 237) (=#7C3AED) accent. ACTIVE pill appeared on the BUILD YOUR OWN row. (T2) Tapped custom-accent-#0891B2 + custom-mode-light + custom-apply: PATCH 200, payload preset_id='custom', bg=#F8FAFC, accent=#0891B2; appearance bg flipped to rgb(248, 250, 252) live. (T3) Hex validation: 'ZZZ' (3 letters) and 'abc' (3 chars) both correctly rejected — input text remained populated and accent did NOT change; valid '22c55e' (entered without leading #) was accepted — input cleared and Apply-button bg flipped to rgb(34, 197, 94) confirming the accent updated, then Apply persisted custom #22C55E to backend (verified via fetch /api/household → theme.custom.accent='#22C55E'). (T4) Tapped theme-preset-green_black: PATCH body {preset_id:'green_black'} (no custom block), ACTIVE pill disappeared from BUILD YOUR OWN row; tapping custom-apply again sent PATCH {preset_id:'custom', custom:{accent:'#22C55E', bg:'#F8FAFC', ...}} and ACTIVE pill returned. (T5) PERSISTENCE: removed cheerplanner:theme_palette_v1 from localStorage, hard-reloaded /dashboard, ThemeContext.refreshPresets() restored the custom palette — AsyncStorage cache was rewritten with id='custom', presetId='custom', and a direct GET /api/household responded 200 with theme={preset_id:'custom', custom:{accent:'#22C55E', accentSubtle:'#22C55E22', bg:'#F8FAFC', card:'#FFFFFF', textPrimary:'#0F172A', tabActive:'#22C55E'}}. (Regression) The 12 preset cards still apply correctly (green_black and red_white both verified live; previously-migrated dashboard repainted with no remount). CLEANUP DONE: ended the session by tapping theme-preset-red_white → PATCH 200 with body {preset_id:'red_white'}; final GET /api/household theme={preset_id:'red_white', custom:null}, appearance bg=rgb(248,250,252). Production state is back to default red_white.
critical_code_review_comments: (Minor / cosmetic, NOT blocking) /app/frontend/app/settings/appearance.tsx: ACCENT_SWATCHES contains 12 colors (e.g. #7C3AED), and the swatch testIDs are rendered as 'custom-accent-#7C3AED' i.e. with a literal '#' character. Playwright handles this fine via attribute-CSS selector ([data-testid="custom-accent-#7C3AED"]), but get_by_test_id may struggle with the '#'. The agent_to_agent note already flagged this; no code change required.

(Optional UX) onHexSubmit silently ignores invalid input — user gets no feedback that 'ZZZ' was rejected. Behavior matches the spec ('silently ignored'), but a subtle red border or shake on invalid hex would be friendlier. Not required.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only request, backend interactions exercised via UI)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — 5/5 review-request scenarios pass (apply dark+accent live + persist, apply light+different-accent live + persist, persistence-after-reload via refreshPresets, switch-away-and-back, hex validation), plus regression preset cards still apply

context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom theme builder is fully working end-to-end. Important verified contract: PATCH /api/household/theme accepts both {preset_id:<id>} for the 12 presets and {preset_id:'custom', custom:{accent, accentSubtle, bg, card, textPrimary, tabActive}} for the custom theme; GET /api/household returns theme.preset_id ('custom' or one of the 12) plus theme.custom (object when preset_id==='custom', else null). ThemeContext.refreshPresets() correctly reads household.theme.custom on cold start and rebuilds the palette without any flash of red_white. The previously-noted dashboard bootstrap refreshPresets() (added in iteration 29) is still in place and is what makes T5 persistence work — do not remove it. The Sign-In testID is 'login-submit-button' and the home gear icon testID is 'settings-gear' (NOT 'dashboard-settings-button' as one might guess); auth token is stored in localStorage under key 'ct_auth_token' (JSON-encoded string). Bottom-tab 'Home' label is not directly clickable via text-locator (covered by the tab pressable), so use direct URL navigation (router.push('/dashboard')) for tests. Household theme has been left on red_white at the end of this session — production default is preserved.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this iteration validated a new feature (Custom theme builder). Note: during the first attempt at the test script the agent used get_by_text('Sign in') to submit the login form which silently did NOT trigger the onPress handler; this resulted in an unauthenticated session and a 401 on PATCH /api/household/theme on that first run. Switching to '[data-testid="login-submit-button"]' fixed it and all subsequent PATCH calls returned 200. The 401 was a TEST-HARNESS artefact, NOT a product bug — the actual feature works correctly.
